reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The Helm option `endpointStatus` has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: Values set under endpointStatus no longer take effect; the additional endpoint statuses in the CiliumEndpoints CRD are no longer provided.
consequence.remediation: Remove endpointStatus keys and monitor endpoints via Cilium metrics (cilium_policy, cilium_policy_endpoint_enforcement_status, cilium_controllers_failing, cilium_endpoint_state) or `cilium-dbg endpoint get`.

proposed.statement: The Helm option `endpointStatus` was removed in Cilium 1.16; use Cilium metrics (e.g. cilium_policy, cilium_endpoint_state) or `cilium-dbg endpoint get` instead of additional CiliumEndpoints CRD statuses.
